text:
yara: Heads-up: release stuck on regen diff from sample-app onboarding. tiny types reorder but changelog bot suggested a minor bump and merge guard blocked publish
ci-bot: buildkite: #6302 failed in regen step (yarn regen -> git diff) :x:
bobby: minimal diff:
```diff
- export interface StartFlow { name: string; org?: string }
+ export interface StartFlow { org?: string; name: string }
```
anya: same nondeterministic OpenAPI ordering we've been chasing. typegen has `--stable` but it's opt-in and folks forget it
yara: short fixes I'd like to land quickly: 1) add `src/generated/**` and `src/openapi/**/*.generated.ts` to .semver-ignore 2) commit a stable regen (`yarn typegen --stable`) 3) set REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false at workflow level so CI doesn't stall on interactive onboarding
changelog-bot: changelog: Detected tracked file changes -> suggested bump: minor
ops-bot: note: some runners still use node 18; pinging infra to pin node 20 across runners to avoid prettier/tsc formatting churn
bobby: also adding a tiny CI pre-merge check `yarn typegen --stable --check` to fail early if golden files were not regenerated locally
anya: long-term: make deterministic output the default (flip `--stable` on), and add a husky precommit hook or lint-staged check so devs run typegen automatically on affected files
yara: I'll open one PR that adds .semver-ignore + CI check + workflow env. Bobby can follow with the husky precommit PR and PR template update ("Did you run `yarn typegen --stable`?")
ci-bot: yara pushed fix -> rerunning build :arrow_forward:
ci-bot: buildkite: #6302 rerun passed :white_check_mark: changelog-bot: consulted .semver-ignore -> no bump suggested
anya: follow-ups: RFC to default deterministic typegen, infra ticket for node parity, and add regen checklist to devex docs. thanks team! :rocket:
